title: Changing the font in rpg maker vx ace

posts.author: wbthehero
posts.body: SO I have looked online for info but a lot of the things I found did not give a direct answer, so I need to change the font for a game I am making because the default font for it does not fit the retro 8-bit game style I am going for, However unlike MV there is no font folder so I do not know where to put the font I need nor where to go to change the font, One post said the main file but I cannot find that, another said I have to create a font folder? but that did not work as I expected, so I am currently stumped as to how to do this.

posts.author: Tw0Face
posts.body:
The folder needs to be named
Fonts
. You need to create it first. This folder is where you put in your font.
Main is in the Main Process of the Script Editor, and it says this.
Ruby:
#==============================================================================
# ** Main
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This processing is executed after module and class definition is finished.
#==============================================================================

rgss_main { SceneManager.run }
Just replace it with this.
Ruby:
#==============================================================================
# ** Main
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This processing is executed after module and class definition is finished.
#==============================================================================

  Font.default_name = ["ThisIsTheNameOfYourPixelFont"] # Edit as you see fit.
  Font.default_size = 24 # Edit as you see fit.
  rgss_main { SceneManager.run }
There's even more you could include here in case you need it, like Font.default_italic and Font.default_bold. Remember to always have rgss_main { SceneManager.run } as the last line.

As Tw0Face showed the font is changed in the code anywhere above main in the script editor.
Ruby:
#==============================================================================
# ** Main
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This processing is executed after module and class definition is finished.
#==============================================================================

  Font.default_name = ["ThisIsTheNameOfYourPixelFont"] # Edit as you see fit.
  Font.default_size = 24 # Edit as you see fit.
  rgss_main { SceneManager.run }
The name of the font specified in the code is the font name, not the file name
